title: AB-PMJAY for Senior Citizens aged 70+ Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Ayushman Bharat health coverage pathway for eligible senior citizens aged 70 years and above, subject to the currently notified rules and beneficiary enrolment process.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Indian citizens aged 70 years and above are the core target group under the senior-citizen expansion; applicable enrolment, Aadhaar/identity and scheme rules must be checked at the official portal.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under AB-PMJAY for Senior Citizens aged 70+.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
